title: Sending money from Israel
question: How can I send money from Israel to my family?
answer: You can send money through licensed transfer companies, banks, or digital transfer services. Compare the fee, exchange rate, delivery time, and whether the receiver needs cash pickup or bank deposit.

title: Before choosing a transfer company
question: How do I choose a money transfer company?
answer: Use a licensed company, ask for the total fee, check the exchange rate, and keep the receipt. Do not send money through someone you do not trust.
